title: AI-Based Identification Method for Cervical Transformation Zone Within Digital Colposcopy: Development and Multicenter Validation Study.
summary: The colposcopy model classifies cervical transformation zones across six hospitals and an independent set; its bounded clinical reference performance is directly reported.
ai_technology: A multiscale neural network classifies colposcopic transformation-zone types and segments the new squamocolumnar junction.
organization: School of Population Medicine and Public Health, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences and Peking Union Medical College, Beijing, China

evidence.tested: The colposcopy model classifies cervical transformation zones across six hospitals and an independent set; its bounded clinical reference performance is directly reported.
evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
